services.name: Annual check-up
services.short: A full yearly review with time for your questions.
services.text: A relaxed yearly visit to review your health, update vaccinations and plan any tests. Bring a list of questions; we leave time for them.
expect: Blood pressure, weight and a short physical exam
A review of medicines you take
Advice on screening that suits your age
A plan for any follow-up tests

services.name: Same-week sick visit
services.short: Coughs, fevers, rashes and other everyday illness.
services.text: A short visit for illness that came on recently. We keep slots open every day for this, so you rarely wait more than a day or two.
expect: A short talk about your symptoms
Advice, and a prescription if needed

services.name: Travel health advice
services.short: Vaccines and advice before you travel abroad.
services.text: Planning a trip? We go through the vaccines and medicines you may need for where you are going. Book at least six weeks before you leave.
expect: Bring your travel dates and route
Vaccines given on the day where possible
A printed summary to take with you

services.name: Vaccinations & flu shot
services.short: Seasonal flu shots and routine adult vaccines.
services.text: Quick visits for flu shots and routine adult vaccines. Please wait in the clinic for 15 minutes afterwards.
expect: A short check before the vaccine
The vaccine itself takes a minute
15 minutes in the waiting room afterwards

services.name: Blood tests
services.short: Early-morning blood draws, results in 2 to 3 days.
services.text: Blood draws in our lab room. Some tests need you to skip breakfast; we tell you when you book by phone.
expect: The draw takes about five minutes
We message you when results are ready

services.name: Check-up & clean
services.short: Exam, scale and polish, and advice for your teeth.
services.text: Our most-booked dental visit: a full check of teeth and gums, a scale and polish, and simple advice to keep your smile healthy.
expect: A check of teeth, gums and bite

services.name: Fillings
services.short: Tooth-coloured fillings for cavities and chips.
services.text: Tooth-coloured fillings that match your teeth. Most fillings take one visit.
expect: Numbing so you feel no pain
A tooth-coloured filling shaped to your bite

services.name: Toothache visit
services.short: Same-week help for pain or a broken tooth.
services.text: In pain or broke a tooth? We keep short slots open every day to see you quickly and make you comfortable.
expect: A look at the problem tooth
Pain relief and a plan for treatment

services.name: Teeth whitening
services.short: In-clinic whitening in a single visit.
services.text: A one-hour in-clinic whitening with a check first to make sure it suits your teeth.
expect: A quick check that whitening is safe for you
Aftercare tips to keep the shade

services.name: Children's dental visit
services.short: Gentle check-ups for children from age one.
services.text: A calm first look at little teeth, with time to get comfortable in the chair. Parents stay with their child the whole time.
expect: Time to sit in the chair and play
A gentle check of teeth and gums

services.name: First assessment
services.short: A full assessment and a plan for your recovery.
services.text: Your first physiotherapy visit: we listen, test how you move and agree a plan with you. Wear comfortable clothes.
expect: A talk about the problem and your goals
An exercise plan to take home

services.name: Follow-up session
services.text: Follow-up sessions to treat, check your progress and move your exercises on.

services.name: Sports injury rehab
services.short: Get back to running, gym or team sport.
services.text: Rehab built around your sport, from sprains to post-surgery return to play.

services.name: Back & neck care
services.short: Relief and exercises for back and neck pain.
services.text: Treatment and simple daily exercises for back and neck pain, including desk-work strain.

services.name: Well-child visit
services.short: Growth checks and milestones from birth to 16.
services.text: Regular check-ups to follow your child's growth and development, with plenty of time for your questions.

services.name: Childhood vaccinations
services.short: Routine vaccines on the national schedule.
services.text: Routine childhood vaccines in a calm room, with a sticker at the end.

services.name: Newborn visit
services.short: A first check for babies in their first weeks.
services.text: A gentle first visit for your baby, usually in the first two weeks, with time for feeding and sleep questions.
expect: A plan for the first vaccines

providers.name: Dr. Amelia Hart
providers.title: Family physician
providers.bio: Dr. Hart has looked after Willowmere families for more than twelve years. She enjoys preventive care and takes time to explain results in plain words.
education: MD, Halden University School of Medicine

providers.name: Dr. Rafael Ortiz
providers.title: Family physician
providers.bio: Dr. Ortiz looks after adults of every age and runs our travel health service. He is known for unhurried visits and clear advice.

providers.name: Dr. Nadia Okafor
providers.title: Dentist
providers.bio: Dr. Okafor is a general dentist with a gentle touch, and a favourite with nervous patients and children.

providers.name: Dr. Lukas Brenner
providers.title: Dentist
providers.bio: Dr. Brenner focuses on restorative and cosmetic dentistry, from fillings to whitening, and explains each option before he starts.

providers.name: Mei Tanaka
providers.title: Dental hygienist
providers.bio: Mei runs our hygiene room. Her cleanings are thorough and calm, and she gives simple, practical advice for home care.

providers.name: Sofia Lindqvist
providers.title: Physiotherapist
providers.bio: Sofia treats sports injuries, back and neck pain and recovery after surgery. She builds plans around the activities you love.
education: Doctor of Physical Therapy, Northgate University

providers.name: Dr. Grace Muriuki
providers.title: Pediatrician
providers.bio: Dr. Muriuki cares for children from newborns to teens. Parents value her calm manner and the time she gives to every question.
education: MD, Halden University School of Medicine

faqs.q: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.a: Choose a service on the Book page, pick a clinician or let us choose, then pick a time. You get a booking code straight away.

faqs.q: Can I change or cancel my appointment?
faqs.a: Yes. Open My appointment with your booking code and the email or phone number you booked with. You can change the time or cancel up to 24 hours before.

faqs.q: What if I am running late?
faqs.a: Call the front desk. If you are more than 10 minutes late we may need to move you to a later time so other patients are not kept waiting.
Yes, every team welcomes new patients. Tick "New patient" when you book so we allow a little extra time for paperwork.

faqs.q: Which insurance plans do you accept?
faqs.a: We work with the plans listed on this page. If yours is not listed, you can still be seen as a self-pay patient.
Yes, free parking behind the clinic, with two accessible bays next to the entrance.

faqs.q: Can I bring my child to my appointment?
faqs.a: Of course. We have a small play corner in the waiting room.

home.title: Care for every age, close to home
home.text: Family doctors, dentists, a physiotherapist and a children's doctor in one calm, friendly clinic. Book online in under a minute.

about.title: One clinic, four teams
about.text: Willowmere Clinic brings everyday health care together under one roof, so the whole family can be seen in one place, often on the same day. Our clinicians share notes and refer to each other, which means fewer forms and fewer trips.

firstvisit.title: Your first visit
firstvisit.text: A few simple steps make your first visit quick and easy.

items.name: Book online or call
items.text: Pick a service and time that suits you. Tick New patient so we allow a few extra minutes.

items.name: Arrive 10 minutes early
items.text: Check in at the front desk. We will confirm your contact details and insurance.

items.name: Meet your clinician
items.text: Your visit starts on time. Ask anything; we will explain each step.

items.name: Leave with a plan
items.text: Book any follow-up at the desk or online, and get a printed summary if you like.

directions.title: Getting here
directions.text: We are on the corner of Larkspur Lane and Mill Street, two minutes' walk from the town square.

items.name: By car
items.text: Free parking behind the clinic, with two accessible bays by the door.

items.name: By bus
items.text: Routes 4 and 12 stop on Mill Street, right outside.

items.name: By bike
items.text: Covered bike racks next to the main entrance.

items.name: Access
items.text: Step-free entrance, a lift to the first floor and an accessible restroom.

policy.title: Cancellations
policy.text: Please cancel or change at least 24 hours before your visit so we can offer the time to someone else. You can do this online with your booking code.
